test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is a proven fact that _______ living being can survive without water.
solution:
The correct answer is **'No'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank needs to be filled with a word that indicates the negation of the subject "**living being**."
 
• The correct word to use here is "**no**," as it appropriately negates the subject in a grammatically correct manner.
 
• The phrase "**no living being**" correctly implies that zero living beings can survive without water.
 
• Thus, the correct option to fill in the blank is **no**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It is a proven fact that **no**__ living being can survive without water."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "none"** – This option is incorrect as "none" is not correctly used before the singular noun "living being."
 
• **Option 3: "any"** – This option is incorrect as it does not negates the subject but instead implies potential.
 
• **Option 4: "neither"** – This option is incorrect as "neither" is used to refer to two items, not a general noun like "living being."
